_meta.what_this_is: Candidate chunks retrieved for a query that needs several sub-topics answered (a drug question needing dosage, side effects, and interactions). Each chunk has a relevance score to the query and a topic label. Three of the chunks are about dosage and near-duplicates of each other. Pure top-k by relevance picks the three dosage chunks -- highest scores, but redundant -- and never surfaces side effects or interactions, so the answer built from them is incomplete. MMR (maximal marginal relevance) balances relevance against novelty and covers the distinct sub-topics.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Relevance scores and topics hand-authored so the top-k redundancy and the MMR coverage are exact and checkable. Similarity is 1.0 within a topic, low across topics.
_meta.format: k (how many to select); lambda (MMR relevance-vs-novelty weight); needed_topics; chunks [{id, relevance, topic}]
